introduction: Follow the lord’s four independent offerings and prepare exact potions with the frail man below the village inn. Distinguish the hidden materials, consumed recipe, separate keys and unresolved blue-horn supply before following the larger dragon prophecy.
orientation: The lord accepts four independent offerings: blue-tinged horn, granular potion, small black gem and small dragon tooth. The frail man’s four potion recipes are supporting services; asked keywords and ambient actions do not each award an achievement.

The little-used road connects Cheltenham to the wider Surface. Follow Chiltern Way to the village square; west from its northern part is the Apples and Wheat Inn. Go south to the common room, west to the taproom, north to the kitchen, down through the stores and dark stair, then west to the frail man’s laboratory.

Granular preparation needs sand and the recipe scroll together and consumes both for three potions. The water dragon at the end of the inn’s underwater passage wears the hidden sand. The foreign humble hermit trades a woven neberihide necklace and birdfeather headdress together for the recipe; supplied exact materials can skip those earlier routes.

The hunched podaling’s paid headdress and necklace preparation and Carmotee’s epic smelt purchase are currently unavailable while accounting is active. An exact supplied recipe remains valid for the frail man. Earlier receipts explain preparation without replacing present materials or proving personal recovery.

The tiny waterfall on the plateau is a separate route: look behind it and take the open downward passage into the mines; no SEARCH is required for this entrance. The crystal dragon carries the frost recipe’s white horn and the onyx dragon carries an unrelated blackened horn. The sapphire dragon does not currently carry the lord’s blue-tinged horn; its exact supply route remains unresolved.

In the castle, the lord is in the audience chamber south of the main hall junction. The western hallway leads to the locked spiral stair. Only one of its six guards carries the onyx key. It breaks on ordinary successful unlocking; upstairs past the library, the lich carries the black gem.

The lord’s black-gem reward opens the hidden eastern catacomb gate beyond the neglected tunnels. Reach those tunnels through the prison’s hidden northern stair. At the prison entrance one golem carries the decayed portal key and the other wields the protective recipe’s curved rod. The decayed key breaks on ordinary successful unlocking; the golden catacomb key survives.

The spectral warrior carries the small tooth in the catacombs. A supplied tooth skips the gem-and-key route. The lord’s tooth key fits the locked foreign black-marble gate beyond his southern hallway and breaks on ordinary successful unlocking. Crossing that boundary and defeating a dragon need their own facts.

Search the hiding place east along the shrubs north of the wheat fields for the exact white flower. The pink flowers described on the shrubs do not substitute, and no gardener belt is required. T’Sharenoa’s delicate iron wand also does not substitute for the curved golem rod.

The plaque and lord’s prophecy explain the dragon threat. Drawbridge chains, collapsing-bridge warnings, spoken prison wards, healing-water lore and the gnome’s notebook are not additional accepted quest outcomes in the current map. No prison rescue, campaign victory or potion use is inferred from an offering.

Carry exact offering materials loose. Worn, nested, spent and handed-away copies remain missing; supplied copies need no personal source kill. Only accepted exact exchanges record outcomes. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen reward recovery remains separate.

contacts.name: Lord Du'Maathe
contacts.description: In the audience chamber, with mages and elite guards. Ask about fool, help, talent, hero and proof. His four exact offerings are independent outcomes; his prophecy does not require doing them in a fixed order.

contacts.name: a frail man
contacts.description: In the laboratory west of the dark stair below the Apples and Wheat Inn. Ask about recipes and granular, frost, protective or homely potions. Every batch needs its exact materials; the granular recipe consumes two inputs and creates three potions.

contacts.name: a water dragon
contacts.description: At the end of the underwater passage below the village inn. Wears the exact hidden handful of sand. Ordinary body parts do not substitute.

contacts.name: a crystal dragon
contacts.description: In the mine passages beneath the plateau waterfall. Carries the exact hidden pure white horn for the frost potion.

contacts.name: a sapphire dragon
contacts.description: In the mine passages beneath the waterfall. Its active reset does not carry the lord’s blue-tinged horn; that exact item’s producer remains unresolved.

contacts.name: an onyx dragon
contacts.description: In the mine passages beneath the waterfall. Carries a blackened horn, which satisfies none of the castle’s eight offerings.

contacts.name: a lich of Du'Maathe castle's arch-mage
contacts.description: At the top of the castle spire beyond the locked stair. Carries the hidden small black gem for the lord’s golden catacomb key.

contacts.name: a Du'Maathe castle stair guard
contacts.description: Six guards begin around the locked spiral stair entrance. Only one of the four at the entrance carries the intricate onyx key.

contacts.name: a spectral warrior
contacts.description: In the catacombs beyond the neglected tunnels’ hidden locked eastern wall. Carries the exact small dragon tooth; nearby spectres are different actors.

contacts.name: a stone golem
contacts.description: Two stone golems begin at the prison entrance. One carries the decayed key for the northern portal; the other wields the curved iron rod for protective preparation.

contacts.name: a goblin shaman
contacts.description: In a prison cell, wears the Gruneegth tribe’s totem. A goblin traveler in Alatorin’s Frothing Mug accepts it for a skull belt; that exchange belongs to Alatorin, and no local rescue outcome is recorded.

contacts.name: Carmotee
contacts.description: The castle blacksmith off the northern wall road is an epic smelt teacher through the shared teacher table. Epic skill purchases are currently unavailable while accounting is active; repair prose does not add a repair quest.

contacts.name: T'Sharenoa
contacts.description: T’Sharenoa sells the delicate iron rod set with a white stone from her supply shop off the northern wall road. It is a wand and does not replace the golem’s curved recipe rod.

contacts.name: a cheltite innkeeper
contacts.description: At the village’s Apples and Wheat Inn entrance. The inn service is separate from the frail man’s laboratory below its kitchen and stores.

contacts.name: the innkeep of the Du'Maathe castle inn
contacts.description: At the castle square inn entrance. Its room inn service is separate from the village inn and the eight accepted exchanges.

steps.text: Optional local route: carry the golden catacomb key
steps.hint: From the spiral stair descend twice to the prison entrance. Descend the dark stair to the neglected tunnels, search the eastern wall at the catacomb entrance and unlock it with the golden key. Ordinary unlocking preserves this golden key.
